string-array.name: tricky_borders
string-array.item: Morocco|Spain|Spain and Morocco share a land border: the Spanish cities of Ceuta and Melilla are on the North African coast.
Azerbaijan|Turkey|Turkey borders Azerbaijan through Nakhchivan, a part of Azerbaijan cut off from the rest of the country by Armenia.
Afghanistan|People\'s Republic of China|Afghanistan reaches China through the Wakhan Corridor, a long, narrow strip of land high in the Pamir mountains.
Lithuania|Russia|Lithuania borders Russia at Kaliningrad, a part of Russia on the Baltic coast between Lithuania and Poland.
Norway|Russia|Norway and Russia share a short border in the far north, above the Arctic Circle.
North Korea|Russia|North Korea and Russia share a very short border along the Tumen River, near the Sea of Japan.
Botswana|Zambia|Botswana and Zambia meet at Kazungula on the Zambezi River, where their border is only a few hundred metres long.
Namibia|Zambia|Namibia reaches Zambia through the Caprivi Strip, a long, narrow arm of land in Namibia\'s north-east.
France|Kingdom of the Netherlands|France and the Kingdom of the Netherlands share the Caribbean island of Saint Martin.
Cyprus|United Kingdom|The United Kingdom borders Cyprus through Akrotiri and Dhekelia, two British bases on the island.

string-array.name: missing_borders
string-array.item: Mauritania|Morocco|Morocco and Mauritania don\'t share a border in this puzzle: Western Sahara lies between them.
